about: What the real pose tracker reported for test/fixtures/body/leans.webm, 15 times a second: a rendered person bending sideways at the waist. From 1 to 11 seconds the bend goes evenly from 20 degrees to their left to 20 degrees to their right, at the top of the spine: (t - 6) * 4 degrees. Then they lean to their right from 13 to 14 seconds, hold it at 16 degrees until 16.5, are upright from 17.5 to 18.5, lean to their left and hold it from 19.5 to 22, and are upright from 23. Only the nose, shoulders and hips are kept: each is [x, y, z, how sure], as shares of the picture, which is not mirrored.
